name: Sky God Revelation
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
When a Level 10 monster with ? ATK is Normal Summoned to your field, each player can draw until they have 6 cards in their hand.
Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can activate 1 of these Skills:
● Reveal 1 "Slifer the Sky Dragon" in your hand, place it on the bottom of the Deck, then draw 1 card.
● Once per Duel, discard 1 card, then add 1 "Slifer the Sky Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Executive Privilege
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
"Obelisk the Tormentor" can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each.
Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can activate 1 of these Skills:
● Reveal 1 "Obelisk the Tormentor" and "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" in your hand, place them on the bottom of the Deck in any order, then draw 2 cards.
● Once per Duel, discard 1 card, then add 1 "Obelisk the Tormentor" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Battle City Slugger
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
All Warrior monsters you control gain 100 ATK for each Warrior monster you control.
Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can activate 1 of these Skills:
● Reveal 1 "Gilford the Lightning", "Insect Queen", "Jinzo", or "The Legendary Fisherman" in your hand, place it on the bottom of the Deck, then draw 1 card.
● Once per Duel, discard 1 card, then add 1 "Gilford the Lightning" from your Deck to your hand, then you can Tribute Summon 1 Warrior monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.

name: Advent of Ra
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
When you Tribute Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra", its original ATK/DEF become the combined original ATK/DEF of the monsters Tributed for its Summon.
Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can activate 1 of these Skills:
● Reveal 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster in your hand, place it on the bottom of the Deck, then draw 1 card.
● Once per Duel, you can discard 1 card, then add 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Fear of the Dark
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
While "Dark Necrofear" is face-up on your field, "Destiny Board" and "Spirit Message" cards you control are unaffected by your opponent's card effects. If a "Spirit Message" card would be placed on your field with "Destiny Board", you can Special Summon it as a Normal Monster (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) instead. It cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly. Once per turn, you can reveal 1 "Spirit Message" card in your hand and place it on the bottom of the Deck, then draw 1 card.

name: As I Predicted...!
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw, you may look at the top 2 cards of your Deck, add 1 to your hand, then send the other to the GY. If you do, skip your next Battle Phase.
Apply the following Skills:
● Only you need 15 or more cards in your GY to activate "Exchange of the Spirit".
● If you have 15 or more cards in your GY, you can banish 1 "Exchange of the Spirit" from your GY to activate its effect.

name: Royal Temple of the Kings
desc:
At the start of the Duel, place this card in your Field Zone and flip it over.
"Royal Temple of the Kings" is unaffected by your opponent's card effects. "Mystical Beast of Serket" cannot be destroyed by its own effect. Once per turn: You can pay 500 LP; this turn, you can activate a Continuous Trap Card with an effect that Special Summons itself as a monster, the turn it was Set.

name: Tribal Unity
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
"Harpie" monsters are also treated as "Amazoness" monsters and vice-versa, while they are on the field or GY. Once per Duel, you can discard 1 monster to make 1 "Harpie" or "Amazoness" monster you control gain ATK equal to the Level of the discarded monster x 200.

name: Ever Faithful Companions
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" or 1 "Dark Magician Girl" from your hand. Once per Duel, while you control a monster whose original name is "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl", you can add 1 "Dark Magician" or 1 card that mentions it from your Deck to your hand.

name: Symbol of Pride
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
During your Main Phase, you can Tribute Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" by Tributing 1 Tribute Summoned monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. You can discard 1 Spell, then apply 1 of these Skills (but you can only use each of these Skills once per Duel):
● If you control a "Blue-Eyes White Dragon", destroy all monsters your opponent controls, also "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" you control cannot declare an attack this turn.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" using monsters from your hand or field as material, and if you do, it is unaffected by your opponent's card effects until the end of this turn.

name: Red-Eye Inferno
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
You can Tribute Summon "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" for 1 less Tribute for each monster your opponent controls. You can discard 1 Spell, then apply 1 of these Skills (but you can only use each of these Skills once per Duel).
● If you control a "Red-Eyes Black Dragon", inflict 800 damage to your opponent, also "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" you control cannot declare an attack this turn.
● Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster that mentions "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" as material, using monsters from your hand or field as material, and if you do, it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects until the end of this turn.

name: Pulling the Strings
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Apply the following Skills:
● Once per turn, you can give control of 1 face-up monster you control to your opponent, and if you do, it cannot be Tributed.
● Once per Duel, during your opponent's End Phase, you can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls that you own, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent, also for the rest of this Duel, you take no damage from cards you own.

name: Malevolence of the Millennium Ring
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Once per turn, if you control a Fiend monster, you can activate 1 of these Skills (but you can only use each of these Skills once per Duel):
● Send 1 Fiend monster from your Deck to the GY, then lose LP equal to its original Level x 200.
● Discard 1 Fiend monster, lose LP equal to its original Level x 200, then draw 1 card.

name: Keeper of the Valley
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Once per Duel, you can discard 1 card to add 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Necrovalley" from your GY to your hand.
Apply the following Skill:
● Your GY is unaffected by "Necrovalley".

name: Deserts Peril
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Twice per Duel, you can apply the following Skill:
● Flip all monsters you control face-down and shuffle them in your Main Monster Zone, then you can change the battle position of 1 monster you control.
This Skill can only be used once per turn.

name: Harpie's Kaleidoscope
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
"Harpie Lady Sisters" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Monster or Trap effects, also they gain the following effect:
● Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can place 2 WIND Winged Beast monsters from your GY on the bottom of the Deck in any order, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; return it to the hand.

name: See Me Rolling
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, you can add 1 card with an effect that requires a die roll from your Deck to your hand, then place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
Apply the following Skill:
● Once per turn, when you roll a dice for a card or effect, you may re-roll the result once.

name: Battle City Bestie
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Apply the following Skills:
● You take no battle damage during your turn.
● Once per turn, during your End Phase, if your opponent activated a card or effect this turn, draw 1 card.

name: Even the Odds
desc:
Activate this Skill only if your opponent controls exactly 3 cards and you control no cards.
During your Main Phase, you can add 1 card from your Deck to your hand, then place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

name: Noah's Arc
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Once per Duel, you can add 1 "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" or "Shinato's Ark" from your Deck to your hand, then place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
Apply the following Skills:
● Once per turn, if you control a Level 5 or higher Spirit monster or "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane", you can add 1 Spirit monster from your GY to your hand.
● During your turn, you can Normal Summon 1 Spirit monster with the same original name as a monster that was Normal Summoned during your previous turn, in addition to your Normal Summon this turn.

name: Straight out of Neo Space!
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO Neos" from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon, except "Elemental HERO" or "Neo-Spacian" monsters. During your End Phase, if a Fusion Monster you control is returned to your Extra Deck, you can Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO Neos" from your Deck.

name: Destructive Fate
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
During your turn, when you would toss a coin(s) for the effect of a monster or Spell (once per turn for each card type), you may lose half your LP to declare the result(s) instead. During the End Phase of your 3rd turn, flip this card over.

name: Food Chain
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per turn, you can apply 1 of these Skills.
● Destroy 1 Dinosaur or Reptile monster you control, then Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster whose Level is 1 higher from your hand or Deck.
● You can Tribute Summon 1 Dinosaur monster by banishing 2 Dinosaur and/or Reptile monsters from your GY instead of Tributing (it is still treated as a Tribute Summon).

name: Major in Paleontology
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Once per turn, you can banish 1 card from your hand face-down, then place 1 Dig Counter on this Skill (max. 1). If a face-up "Fossil" Fusion Monster(s) you control is destroyed by card effect, you can place 1 Dig Counter on this Skill (max. 1). Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can remove 1 Dig Counter from this Skill to Fusion Summon 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing materials mentioned on it from any GYs (except for materials with a specific GY requirement listed.) (This is treated as a Fusion Summon with "Fossil Fusion".)

name: Wise Man Neos
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
"Elemental HERO Neos" and Fusion Monsters that mention "Elemental HERO Neos" as material gain the following effect.
● Before damage calculation, if this card battles an opponent's monster: You can inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that opponent's monster's original ATK.

name: Magician's Scales
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, you can Tribute 1 "Arcana Force" monster and add 1 Normal Spell from your Deck to your hand, also for the rest of the Duel, you cannot Summon any monsters, except "Arcana Force" monsters.

name: Dino Brain Immunity
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Apply the following Skills.
● The battle positions of Dinosaur monsters cannot be changed by Trap Cards or effects.
● Level 7 or higher Dinosaur monsters on the field cannot be targeted by Spell Cards or effects.

name: Dig Site Inspection
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Once per turn, during your Draw Phase, before you draw, you can excavate the top card of your Deck, and place it on the top or bottom of the Deck. After you placed a second card to the bottom of your Deck with this Skill, flip this card over.

name: "Invitation" to the Society
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
If your opponent's monster is equipped with "White Veil" you control, take control of that monster while it's equipped with "White Veil". You can only attack with monsters equipped with "White Veil" the turn you activate "White Veil".

name: Mokey Mokey Madness
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Apply the following Skill.
● If all monsters you control are "Mokey Mokey" monsters (min. 1), Effect Monsters cannot attack the turn they are Summoned.
Once per Duel, if you control 2 or more Fairy monsters, you can place 1 "Mokey Mokey" Continuous Spell from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone, and if you do, destroy 1 monster you control.
Once per Duel, you can discard 1 card to Fusion Summon 1 "Mokey Mokey King" from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material.

name: Cyberdark Scheme
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these Skills.
● Return 1 face-up or face-down "Cyberdark" monster you control to the hand (reveal it if it is face-down), and if you do, immediately after this Skill resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 "Cyberdark" monster.
● Once per Duel, send 1 Monster Card in your Spell & Trap Zone, equipped to a "Cyberdark" Fusion Monster, to the GY, then equip 1 monster your opponent controls to that monster. "Cyberdark" Fusion Monsters gain ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this Skill.

name: Shouldering a Destiny
desc:
You draw 1 less card at the beginning of the Duel. During your Main Phase, you can activate this Skill as a Continuous Spell Card.
When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Destiny HERO - Plasma" from your Deck or GY to your hand. While you control "Destiny HERO - Plasma", apply the following effects.
● You cannot draw during the Draw Phase.
● Each "Destiny HERO - Plasma" you control gains 100 ATK for each monster in the GYs, cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, also can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

name: Ultimate Wizardry
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
When you activate this Skill, place up to 1 Spell Counter on each face-up Spellcaster monster you control that you can place a Spell Counter on. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can place 1 Spell Counter on a face-up Spellcaster monster you control that you can place a Spell Counter on.

name: Iron Grit
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
"Gearfried the Iron Knight(s)" you control are unaffected by card effects.

name: Whale of a Tale
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Discard 1 card from your hand and add 1 "Fortress Whale" or "Fortress Whale's Oath" from your Deck to your hand. "Fortress Whale" monsters you control gain the following effect:
● Your opponent cannot target face-up WATER monsters you control with Spell/Trap cards or effects.

name: Insect Infestation
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
"Parasite Paracide(s)" on the field cannot be Tributed. If all monsters on the field are Insect monster(s), Level 7 or higher Insect monsters you control can attack directly. Once per Duel, you can discard 1 card, then place 1 "Parasite Paracide" from your GY on top of your opponent's Deck face-up. Treat it as if it were added to their Deck by its effect.

name: Intel from the "Cosmos"
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Your opponent must reveal all cards they draw during their Draw Phase.

name: Stalked by the Rare Hunters
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, during your End Phase, discard 1 card, then choose 1 monster in your opponent's GY that was destroyed and sent there this turn, and Set it on your field.

name: Now You See Them...
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, if you have 2 or more "Dark Magician(s)" in your hand, reveal your hand and place any number of "Dark Magician(s)" from your hand on the bottom of the Deck(s), then draw cards based on how many cards you placed.
● 1: 1 card.
● 2: 3 cards.
● 3: 5 cards.

name: Slimey Slimes
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can destroy 1 "Jam Breeding Machine" you control and 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if you Special Summoned "Revival Jam" by it's own effect this turn, draw 3 cards.

name: The Dragon Hunting Swordsman
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
Once per Duel, you can discard 1 card, then Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster that mentions "Buster Blader", using monsters from your hand or field as material. While the only monster you control is "Buster Blader" or a Fusion Monster that mentions it, monsters in your opponent's GY become Dragons.

name: Heart of a Warrior
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per turn, you can discard 1 card, then Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Warrior non-Effect Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon.) You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you activate this Skill.

name: A Bountiful Ocean
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
While "Umi" is face-up on the field, apply the following:
● Non-Effect WATER monsters you control are unaffected by non-WATER monster effects.
● Once per turn, you can add 1 WATER monster from your GY to your hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot activate cards or effects, until you Normal Summon that monster or a card with its name.

name: My Precious Queen!
desc:
At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.
You can Normal Summon Level 7 Insect monsters for 1 less Tribute. Once per turn, during the End Phase, you can Special Summon 1 "Insect Monster Token" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100). This Token cannot be Tributed, except for the Tribute Summon of an Insect monster or their effects. You can Tribute 1 Insect monster from your hand instead, when attacking with "Insect Queen" monsters you control.

name: The Machine Menace
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, if your opponent controls a face-up Trap, Tribute 1 Machine or Psychic monster you control, then Special Summon 1 "Jinzo" from your hand or GY.

name: Collector
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, if your opponent controls a monster, discard 2 cards with different card types (Monster, Spell, Trap) then add 1 card from your Deck to your hand of the third type.

name: A Terrible Fate
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, during your End Phase, Tribute 1 face-up Spellcaster monster you control, then your opponent destroys 1 card they control or sends 1 card from their hand to the GY (their choice).

name: Slimey Disposition
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 "Humanoid Slime" or 1 "Worm Drake" from your GY in Attack Position, but it cannot be Tributed, except for the Tribute Summon of a Divine-Beast monster. Once per turn, you can discard 1 card, then Fusion Summon 1 "Humanoid Worm Drake" using either "Worm Drake" or "Humanoid Slime" from your field as 1 of the Fusion Materials, and the other material from your Deck.

name: Malicious Motivation
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, if your opponent controls 3 monsters, discard 1 card, then destroy all monsters your opponent controls, also for the rest of this turn, any damage your opponent takes is halved.

name: KaibaCorp Research
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, shuffle 1 monster from your GY into the Main Deck, then send 1 card from your hand to the GY. During your next Draw Phase, draw 2 cards instead of 1.

name: Battle City Siren
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can change the battle position of 1 monster your opponent controls. This turn, the first attack you declare must target that monster. This Skill can only be used twice per Duel.

name: Premature Material
desc:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Once per Duel, lose 800 LP and reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, then Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY whose name is mentioned on that Fusion Monster as material, but its ATK/DEF become 0.
